  Evidence of absence: The test body only asserts three markers: INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in TEMPLATE_COMMAND, INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_MARKER not in COMMAND, and INTERIM_TWIN_FIRST_CLAUDE_MD_MARKER not in CLAUDE_MD. The docstring of the test ("the interim default must be gone") implies broader coverage than the assertions actually provide. Recommended minimal fix: add two assertions inside the existing test — one for the agents.md sentence (e.g. `"Interim until #4785 (issue #4948):"` not in _flat(AGENTS_MD)) and one for the master-session.md Q40 interim clause (e.g. `"Since #4948, stages in this repo record"` not in _flat(MASTER_SESSION_MD)). The change is a contract test extension only, no production code touched.
